title: Pip and the Silly Shape Cookies
moral: When we all help at home, big jobs get done and everyone feels happy.
description: Nana Hoot is too sleepy to bake cookies for the lantern party, so Pip, Tumble and Hazel become her super helpers! Learn circles, squares, triangles, stars and hearts in this funny animated story full of flour clouds, boings and honks, about helping at home, for kids aged 3 to 8.
intro: Hi friends! Welcome to Little Lantern Stories! Today's story is... Pip and the Silly Shape Cookies!

narration.text: Good morning, friends! Today was cookie day at Nana Hoot's cozy tree house!

narration.text: Oh! I'm awake! I'm awake!
narration.speaker: nana

narration.text: Nana, you're super-duper sleepy! Don't worry. We'll be your HELPERS!
narration.speaker: pip

narration.text: HONK! Helpers, reporting for duty!
narration.speaker: tumble

narration.text: First, the flour! But the flour bag was way up on the tippy-top of the cupboard.
Pip jumped. BOING! Too low. BOING! Still too low. Ka-BONK! He bumped right into the cupboard door!
How many times did Pip jump? Count with me!
Three times! Great counting! Then Tumble stretched up his long trunk...
Got it! Ooh, it's tickly... ah... ah... AH-CHOOOO!

narration.text: Next, Nana rolled the dough nice and flat, and showed them her shiny cookie cutters.
Ooh! Cutie-cookers! Super-duper!
narration.speaker: pip

narration.text: Hoo-hoo! Cookie CUTTERS, Pip! This one is round, like the sun. It's a CIRCLE!
narration.speaker: nana

narration.text: Can you draw a circle in the air with your finger? Round and round!
Then Nana's glasses slid down her beak... slide, slide... PLOP! Two more circles in the dough!
Oh my. I'll rest my eyes by the fire. You helpers try the next shapes!
narration.speaker: nana

narration.text: While the cookies baked, the kitchen was a GIANT mess. Flour, bowls and sticky spoons everywhere!
Baking is done! Let's go and play!
narration.speaker: pip

narration.text: Wait, Pip! Tidying up is helping too. Nana is so tired.
narration.speaker: hazel

narration.text: So Pip grabbed the broom. Swish, swish... wibble-wobble... he got all tangled up!
Tumble sucked up soapy water. SPLOOSH! Bubbles everywhere! Scrub, scrub, all clean!
Let's tidy by shapes! Round plates are circles. They go up here!
narration.speaker: hazel

narration.text: DING! The cookies were ready! And Nana Hoot woke up from her snooze by the fire.
I'm awake! I'm awake! Oh my... who made my kitchen so sparkly clean?
narration.speaker: nana

narration.text: We did! Me, Tumble and Hazel! Tidying is helping too!
narration.speaker: pip

narration.text: Look at the cookies! Circle, square, triangle, star and heart. How many shapes is that?
Five shapes! Hooray! You counted them all!

Ah... ah... HIC! Oopsie-trunk! Just a hiccup!
